active_work.scope: unique final pixel winners; reused on light-only updates; unchanged captured primitive tests

appearance.scope: opaque nonmetal direct GGX/Smith + attenuated diffuse; indirect field unchanged

compact_shadows.scope: extra shared immutable view; exact original position/radius/normal bits and IDs; original bank retained; actual bandwidth gain must be measured

kernels.scope: independent stage entry points and reachable helpers; exact original equations; real 1.2 and 1.3 comparison binaries

persistent_visibility.scope: stable source-reference/instance identity; camera independent; per-light position and metric invalidation

shared.scope: source-reference/instance identity and scene; light positions validated on GPU

power_response.scope: lazy per-pixel/per-light direct detail; coarse/indirect transport recomputed unchanged; scalar power only; camera, position, material and options invalidate

screen_tiles.scope: exact per-screen-tile CSR; one pixel owner; unchanged source disks, depth ties and uint material sums; lists reused on light-only updates

source_surface.receiver_queries: once per winning source patch/light; recovered pixels reuse witnessed source

shared_visibility.scope: immutable source visibility; scene hierarchy and writable caches excluded

source_surface.source_geometry: captured tangent disks, shared master IDs
source_surface.visibility_precision: 8 bits per light; eighth light 7 bits

submission.scope: same dependency boundaries; omit restoration of state immediately rebound by every dispatch; whole appearance interval retained

surface_queries.scope: resident world centers/normal intervals; 16-block parents; exact captured-disk blocking witnesses; below 32 storage descriptors use the accepted 1.2 shader

world_plan.scope: source domain + instance assembly + geometry recipe + schedule; camera/light independent

tangent_bounds.scope: refitted bounds only; unchanged original topology, leaves, TLAS, kernels and disk intersections

visibility_stream.scope: spatially ordered final winners; separate per-light cache/witness and exact BLAS kernels; 1.5 page traversal absent; original disks and shadow equations

comparison.scope: Same scene and tight bounds in all four modes. Reference -> direct response -> whole-only timestamps -> lean state transitions. Identical outer GPU interval in all modes; stage deltas retained separately, never added to whole time. Four rotated rounds, fixed separate warm-up and every cold response build retained. Camera and source-position changes use original surface shader without response writes. Indirect transport stays original. No timed GPU buffer/image reads; thermal/frequency uncontrolled.
